summary: PowerShell executing heavily encoded Base64 command argument (>160 characters).

observed_facts.text: Command line contains -EncodedCommand argument with over 160 Base64 characters.

hypotheses.text: Encoded command used to obfuscate script instructions or complex administrative pipeline.

benign_explanations: Legitimate configuration management tools (SCCM, Ansible) occasionally use Base64 encoding.

recommended_actions.reason: Decode and manually inspect the Base64 command payload.

uncertainty_notes: Decoded command content should be analyzed to confirm intent.
